scenes.setting: The Accursed pathway laid bare: Prisoner, Lunatic, Werewolf, Zombie (Maric), Wraith (Sharron) — each with its full-moon curse; the target is Wraith Steve wearing the Scarlet Lunar Corona with Zombie Jason and Werewolf Tyre beside him; spoils split — characteristic to Maric, Corona to Sharron, the rest plus the Book of Secrets to Klein
scenes.text_anchor: “That cursed artifact that needs to be sealed is called ‘Scarlet Lunar Corona.'
